recipe.cache_lifetime: one frozen Qwen feature tree per scene; no current-memory graph across inner
recipe.context_lifetime: Only frozen Qwen features and IL reference memory persist; current memory and KV recomputed each inner
recipe.context_precision: Preserve actual FP32 residual memory; BF16 projected KV; never condition_fp32 recast
recipe.data_order: full NAVTRAIN epoch shuffle; valid padding mask; own-run TRAIN-only priorities
recipe.deployment_lora: preserve attention LoRA wrappers for BF16 parity; merging is not default
recipe.gradient_clipping_reason: New clean-x recipe explicitly applies clip1; original source effective clip0 is not claimed unchanged
recipe.observation_gradient: frozen Qwen features; current memory rebuilt each inner
recipe.reference_observation: permanently frozen original IL40k Qwen and memory

fields.policy_ratio: source relative-clamped FP32 dimension-mean stochastic-transition surrogate
fields.deployment: current-only student memory; clean-x single candidate; shift5 ODE10; frozen LoRA wrappers

parameter_contract.checkpoint_trainable_state: native adapters field contains ALL named trainable tensors, including memory

fields.rng_protocol: independent persistent CPU FP32 generator per rank; source _randn; no repeated candidate seeds
fields.scene_reduction: equal weight per valid fresh scene over all ranks; padding zero; global valid-count denominator

actual_optimizer.lr_field_meaning: registered peak; actual LR is stage peaks times the global exposure multiplier
actual_optimizer.name: torch.optim.AdamW
actual_optimizer.schedule_clock: valid_scene_exposures; repeated Adam inners do not advance the scene clock

data_stream_identity.clock: global scene slots; valid exposures separately counted
data_stream_identity.uniform_cursor: independent source randperm cursor, never incremented by priority or padding

awfm.anchor: exact original IL70 W3 physical mean MSE, beta50
awfm.curvature: A+relu(-A)+1 >=1 in velocity space, not network parameter Hessian
awfm.old: collection-start detached behavior velocity at exactly the same state/sigma/noise
awfm.reduction: mean over MC and all candidates; zero-A candidates retain consistency regularizer

calibration.clock: effective per-rank teacher-slot loss calls, including inner reuse; not Adam updates
calibration.freeze: after100 calls keep last EMA; only diagnose until500, then stop gradient probes; last_measured labels remain explicit
calibration.gradients: all current trainable parameters; local norm, no conditional cross-rank collective; no .grad mutation
calibration.target: norm of current same-microbatch unscaled physical ILmean-MSE gradient

fpo.anchor: exact original IL70 W3 physical mean MSE, beta50
fpo.exclusions: no ASPO, critic, entropy bonus, endpoint-density or full FPO++ claim
fpo.old: collection-start behavior energy detached and fixed across native inner updates
fpo.ratio: exp(E_old-E_current) separately per MC; CFM surrogate, not endpoint likelihood

history.admission: own-run actualTRAIN B1 from phase2 nominal probes; runtime stage admits, never NAV or sampled teacher
history.dominated: if currentB1 strict-high andscore>teacher+1e-6: h0 thiswindow, upgradebank forlaterpolicyversion
history.loss: same normalized .75CFMvelocityMSE+.25B1-last-stateSmoothL1; currentMemory rebuilt; scales read-only fromnominal calibration, fallback1
history.selection: one proactive private-RNG historical scene per rank/collection, only teacher.update<current.update
history.target: prior policy-version actualB1 normalized clean endpoint; no oldpolicy density or PG replay

performance_implementation_protocols.stage_learning_rate: stage per-group peaks multiplied by the same global exposure schedule; LR floor is not restarted at stage transitions

temporal.all_failed: A_safe=mean(full_c)-full_c; not restricted to old coarse ties; A_EP=0
temporal.all_feasible: original SafetyEP raw credit bit-exact; no temporal modification
temporal.canonical: original scores/records and actor inputs unchanged; parent finalizes fresh global raw-A std
temporal.complete_cost: c_ind+.15*(1-t_collision/4) if actual event+.10*(1-t_TTC/4) if actual event+.10*mean(actual DACflags[1:41])
temporal.initial_state: actual t=0 event contributes its stated term; DAC t0 flag reported, post-t0 duration still used
temporal.interpretation: weighted failed-trajectory cost, not accident severity, canonical success or a safety guarantee
temporal.missing: retain indicator; omit only the unavailable event/duration term with explicit audit; null is not a 4s event
temporal.mixed: only unsafe get centered full-cost correction; multiplier <=1 bounded by half actual feasible-credit gap and half negative slack

limits: Real world8 qualification from fresh IL70; not new NAVTEST or a long-run speed claim. Timings/own-run labels/cache payloads are not mathematical equality fields.
